acceptanceCriteria: startAdvisory reports locally known non-default remote-tracking branches with exact names and heads
the discovered default remote branch and symbolic remote HEAD are excluded
remote branch observation is advisory, does not delete refs, and does not block unrelated starts
regression coverage proves a stale remote-tracking branch is visible before implementation
The discovered remote default branch is selected from local remote HEAD metadata; no main/master fallback is used, and a non-main default branch is covered by regression evidence.
goal: Prevent untracked remote branch residue from escaping the start handoff and keep result completion separate from cleanup
intent: Make the Work Item start advisory inventory locally known non-default remote-tracking branches

scenarioCoverage.expected: A locally known non-default remote-tracking branch is emitted with its exact ref name and commit head before a new Work Item proceeds.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the lifecycle_entry regression with an origin/main default ref and an origin/codex/stale remote-tracking ref.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The discovered default branch and symbolic remote HEAD are omitted, while unrelated remote-tracking branches remain advisory and do not delete refs or block an unrelated start.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the same regression and assert only the non-default branch is reported; inspect that the test repository still retains its refs.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A repository whose unique discovered remote default branch is trunk excludes origin/trunk and its symbolic origin/HEAD from residual-branch advisory output, while origin/codex/stale remains visible.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the lifecycle_entry regression start_advisory_reports_non_default_remote_tracking_branches with trunk as the discovered default branch.
